input.content: You are an OpenAirInterface 5G operator. Each user message contains rolling 5-second cell and UE telemetry. Choose exactly one tool call per turn from the configured action space to relieve congestion or stand pat with `noop`. Respect the parameter ranges; the env rejects out-of-range arguments and penalizes the same step's reward. In replay, accepted tools update deterministic synthetic state. No tool controls live OAI/FlexRIC.
Inspect the observed telemetry and choose exactly one safe congestion-control tool call or noop.

tools.description: Select the synthetic per-cell scheduler setpoint. Replay models PF as the neutral baseline, RR as fairness-oriented, and MaxCI as throughput-oriented with a fairness tradeoff.
tools.name: set_scheduler_policy

tools.description: Cap the maximum PRBs allocated per scheduling round to a single UE. Used to throttle a hog UE that is starving the rest of the cell.
tools.name: set_prb_cap

max_prb.description: Hard cap on PRBs per slot for this target.

target.description: The cap applies to one observed UE.

target_id.description: UE id exactly as listed under the selected cell.

tools.description: Constrain the MCS index range the scheduler may select per UE, plus an outer-loop link-adaptation BLER target. Useful when channel estimates are noisy and the default MCS picker oscillates.
tools.name: set_mcs_bounds

mcs_max.description: Upper bound on MCS index. Must be >= mcs_min.

mcs_min.description: Lower bound on MCS index (3GPP 38.214 Table 5.1.3.1-1).

tools.description: Re-weight the per-5QI scheduler priority. Larger weights win more PRBs for that 5QI. Use to defend low-latency 5QIs (e.g. 5QI=1 voice) during congestion.
tools.name: set_qos_weights

tools.description: Tighten or loosen RRC admission. Lowering the accept_threshold admits fewer UEs in synthetic replay. Slice reservations are not modeled, so slice_reservation must be empty.
tools.name: set_admission_policy

accept_threshold_pct.description: RRC accept threshold as a percentage of cell load.

slice_reservation.description: Must be empty; synthetic replay does not model slices.

tools.description: Adjust the A3-event handover trigger: a3_offset_db is the dB margin the neighbour must beat the serving cell by, ttt_ms is the dwell time. Tighter (lower offset, shorter ttt) → more handovers; looser → ping-pong protection.
tools.name: set_handover_trigger

tools.description: Configure uplink fractional path-loss compensation: p0_dbm is the target receive power in dBm, alpha (0..1) is the path-loss compensation fraction. Lowering p0 reduces UE Tx power (good for inter-cell interference), raising alpha hurts cell-edge UEs less.
tools.name: set_ul_power_control

p0_dbm.description: Target receive power per PRB in dBm.

tools.description: Explicitly choose to take no configuration action this step. Required in the action space so the policy can deliberately stand pat instead of guessing a low-impact change.
tools.name: noop
